Gumla men jangli hathi ka kahar...yuvak ko kuchalkar mar dala...yuvak ke pita ne per par charhkar bachaee apni jan..., graminon se satark rahne ki apil
Bokaro men chalti ilektrik skuti men lagi aag...ghatna se mauke par machi aphra-taphri...navadih thana kshetr ke phusro-dumri mukhy marg ki ghatna
Shekhpura men jaruratmandon ke bich bante gae rashan kard...jila mukhyalay men samaroh ka aayojan...vanchit parivaron ko janvitran pranali se jora gaya
